title: Canonical exact comparison and fixed shifts of derived module functors
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], and let $f:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes. For each scheme $T$, write $\Lambda_T$ for the coefficient ring pulled back from the point [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T})$ for the ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Let $P_f=Lf^*:D_Y\to D_X$ and $G_f=Rf_*:D_X\to D_Y$ be the specified total derived functors of the full ordinary module pullback and pushforward [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Put $A_f=D(f^*)$, the exact termwise derived pullback, with its termwise integer shifts [def-weil-triangulated-category]. Define $c_f:P_f\xrightarrow{\sim}A_f$ to be the canonical exact comparison of [def-sfb-left-derived-exact] applied to the specified $P_f$ and its universal left-derived counit. Define the integer-shift structure on $P_f$ by transport of that on $A_f$ through $c_f^{-1}$ (the construction $\operatorname{CommShift.ofIso}(c_f^{-1},\mathbf Z)$). Define the integer-shift structure on $G_f$ to be the published K-injective shift structure of the total right derived functor of $f_*$, obtained from the inverse equivalence $K(\mathrm{Inj})\simeq D_X$ and termwise application of $f_*$; it is fixed independently of any adjunction.
